description: Era-currency companion case: schema-level node 01KYG2BCMEXZFKYNK693KA59J6 (9789 content chars) was consolidated pre-goal (2026-07-26T20:37:32Z, all 5 sources in 2026-07-26T20:36:16Z .. 2026-07-26T20:37:32Z) yet was delivered 2 times in recorded dev recall events during the goal window (2026-08-06T20:52:00Z .. 2026-08-06T21:02:07Z), 0 time(s) at rank 1 and 0 time(s) to organic task-specific queries, with no era or currentness marking. The prior-era schema competes as if current more than 11 days into a different project era. The staleness was later confirmed in the field: the schema was formally superseded on 2026-08-11T14:46:24Z by an in-goal teach correction, and every recorded delivery predates that correction.
expected_behavior: Schemas consolidated in a prior project era must be delivered as unambiguously historical (annotated/downranked) or re-validated against the current era before competing at top ranks; an era-stale schema at rank 1 of an organic in-goal query with zero feedback is the recorded failure signature.
metric_hook_note: era-currency ordering: a currentness-aware rerank changes this schema's recorded ranks; payload secondary (large schema chars leave the delivery)
selection_rule: level=schema AND scope=project:game AND created_at < goal start AND all source_traces pre-goal AND delivered in >=1 recorded event of this split; pick max content_chars
